gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-yantramanav: Stencil bridges and tall, loud letters up top. Yantramanav follows in sans, rounded and spacious in its curves, so the heading's drama gets a modern, tidy partner.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-outfit: Cut-stencil boldness, tall and loud. Outfit's wire-bent curves in sans-serif feel friendlier beside it, a quieter companion that lets Snowburst One be the show.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-display: Glowing tube letters with a splayed c and a big middle zone, loud and confident up front. Noto Sans Display carries that generous height into the text, which makes the two feel related.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-viga: Viga reads in plain sans, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase and no hairlines anywhere. Tilt Neon's tubular strokes make it the louder partner.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-alan-sans: Turret Road's rounds look like open parentheses, drawn with one pen. Alan Sans answers in sans with curve tails held back, so the pair feels sharp yet modern and refined.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-bpmf-huninn: Parenthesis curves, drawn bold and pen-like. Bpmf Huninn keeps a single-weight outline feel in sans, and its wide channels into each bowl make longer text slide by easily.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-cairo: Turret Road brings laser-cut boldness, round forms like open parentheses. Cairo handles the quiet work in sans-serif, its wide channels into every bowl keeping text open where the heading commands attention.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-hanken-grotesk: Pen-drawn parentheses, bold and crisp. Hanken Grotesk adds a wire-bent look in plain sans, and that shared single-line drawing is what ties the two together so naturally.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Bold parentheses drawn with one steady pen. Turret Road excels at commanding headlines, while Noto Sans Cypriot, with its e opening up, is simply friendlier at the body's quieter work in sans.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-tomorrow: Neon-tube rounds, bold and commanding. Turret Road is built to grab attention, whereas Tomorrow's cupped, open bowls in sans-serif are built to settle down and keep the reading smooth.
